_note: Endpoints verified from official docs pages; live calls could not be tested from the research sandbox (network egress blocked). Test before the demo.
recommended_for_hackathon: Open-Meteo (weather + air quality, no key, CORS-friendly) as primary; WAQI with a free token as secondary for station-based AQI.

apis.name: Open-Meteo Forecast
apis.key_note: No key for non-commercial use; commercial use needs apikey and customer-prefixed URL.

apis.name: Open-Meteo Air Quality
apis.caveat: Model-based (CAMS global ~45 km over Asia), not station measurements; may underestimate local valley smoke peaks.

apis.name: WAQI / aqicn.org JSON API
apis.key_note: Free token from https://aqicn.org/data-platform/token/ ; a 'demo' token exists for testing only. Requires attribution to World Air Quality Index Project and originating EPA; no resale/paid use.
apis.confidence_note: URL patterns from widely used community clients; docs page summarised, not all paths shown verbatim.

apis.name: IQAir AirVisual API
apis.key_note: Free Community key from https://www.iqair.com/dashboard/api ; rate limits vary by plan (>10 calls/s errors).
apis.confidence_note: Host api.airvisual.com and query-param form from common usage; verify on docs.

apis.name: Air4Thai (Pollution Control Department, official Thai AQI)
response_fields: AQILast (or LastUpdate in older version) -> AQI.aqi, PM25.value, PM10.value, date, time
apis.caveat: Official Thai AQI scale (differs from US AQI: 37.5 ug/m3 PM2.5 24h = AQI 100). Plain HTTP, possible CORS issues - call from backend. Station ID 35t is an unverified example; fetch the full list and filter areaEN for Chiang Mai.

apis.name: CMU CCDC DustBoy (Chiang Mai University low-cost sensor network)
apis.caveat: Dense Chiang Mai sensor coverage, hourly; API details not verified.

apis.name: TMD API (Thai Meteorological Department)
apis.key_note: Register at https://data.tmd.go.th/api/index1.php to obtain uid/ukey. Docs PDF: https://data.tmd.go.th/api/doc/reference/WeatherForecast7Days_ver2.pdf
apis.caveat: No AQI/UV. Docs could not be opened from sandbox (robots/SSL); exact path/params unverified. Not recommended for a same-day hackathon.
